role: Principal Analytics Engineer, AI Native Self Service Analytics
responsibilities: Shape the technical foundations, modeling standards, and development practices that let Analytics Engineering move faster with greater confidence
Operate as a senior individual contributor who raises the quality of systems, decisions, and execution across teams
Connect Analytics Engineering investments to company priorities and communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders
Contribute to decisions about data modeling, architecture, governance, quality, tooling, and developer experience
Apply agentic coding, AI assisted development and automated workflows where they create clear and measurable value
Strengthen the discipline of Analytics Engineering so data systems become more reliable, understandable, scalable, and useful
